annotations.title: Registered lease: term, unexpired years, flags

description:
Registered leases linked to this UPRN, with the selected longest-expiry
    record and up to ten alternatives, exact register property descriptions,
    title/record identifiers, source/link limitations and computed remaining
    term. UPRN linkage does not verify the legal demise: a garage, parking or
    sibling title must not establish the flat lease. Compare descriptions and
    disclose truncated/unavailable alternatives. Short-term flags are research
    prompts, not legal advice or proof of mortgage eligibility. The AVM does
    not adjust for a short term. `status: no_lease` means none was found; it
    does not independently prove freehold tenure.
    UK only. Costs 5 credits (5p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_lease
